_comment: Dotwork material catalog (Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5): every texture material the world packs draw from. tpl: ground (seen from above), facade (wall seen from the front), roof (roof seen from above). Feeds lane_ground textures and the one-time environment palette extension (palette_extend in README). Seeds are fixed so renders are reproducible.

grass_lush.prompt: lush green grass with small tufts and a few tiny flowers

grass_dry.prompt: dry yellow-green grass with sparse tufts

dirt.prompt: packed brown dirt path with small pebbles

mud.prompt: an even surface of wet dark brown mud with small shiny wet patches, uniform all over

sand.prompt: fine pale beach sand with tiny wind ripples

gravel.prompt: coarse gravel road made of distinct small grey and brown pebbles, uniform all over

cobble.prompt: grey cobblestone street, rounded stones with dark gaps

brick_paving.prompt: red brick paving laid in a herringbone pattern

flagstone.prompt: large flat cream flagstone plaza slabs with thin dark gaps

flower_bed.prompt: a dense flower bed with red and yellow flowers and green leaves

farmland.prompt: tilled brown farmland soil in straight horizontal furrows, uniform all over

moss.prompt: a uniform carpet of soft green moss with tiny lighter tufts

leaf_litter.prompt: forest floor with fallen brown and orange leaves and twigs

ash.prompt: dark grey ash and coal dust ground with small glowing cinders

grating.prompt: dark riveted iron floor grating with square holes

water_shallow.prompt: clear shallow turquoise water surface with a bright caustic light ripple pattern, uniform all over

water_deep.prompt: deep dark blue water with small white ripples

sludge.prompt: a uniform surface of bubbling glowing green toxic sludge with many small bubbles

checker_tile.prompt: a clean checkerboard floor of large black and white square tiles

carpet.prompt: dark red carpet with a small repeating gold diamond pattern, uniform all over

metal_plate.prompt: small square riveted brass floor plates in a repeating grid

snow.prompt: fresh white snow with soft blue shadows and small footprint dents, uniform all over

ice.prompt: pale blue frozen ice surface with white cracks, uniform all over

snow_path.prompt: trampled grey-brown slush and snow path, uniform all over

wall_top.prompt: dark brown wooden beams and boards seen from directly above

hedge.prompt: a dense green hedge of small leaves seen from above, uniform all over

ow_plains.prompt: overworld map grassland seen from very high above, tiny tufts, uniform all over

ow_forest.prompt: overworld map dense forest canopy of many small round tree tops seen from very high above, uniform all over

ow_mountains.prompt: overworld map rocky brown mountain range of many small peaks seen from very high above, uniform all over

ow_desert.prompt: overworld map sandy desert with tiny dunes seen from very high above, uniform all over

ow_snowfield.prompt: overworld map snowfield with tiny drifts seen from very high above, uniform all over

ow_sea.prompt: overworld map deep blue ocean with tiny white wave marks seen from very high above, uniform all over

ow_shallows.prompt: overworld map light turquoise shallow coastal water seen from very high above, uniform all over

ow_swamp.prompt: overworld map murky green swamp with tiny reeds and pools seen from very high above, uniform all over

mine_floor.prompt: a rocky brown mine tunnel floor with gravel and small stones, uniform all over

cave_rock_top.prompt: dark brown solid cave rock mass seen from directly above, uniform all over

timber_plaster.prompt: a timber-framed wall: many small white plaster panels between dark wooden beams, repeating

iron_wall.prompt: a riveted dark iron plate wall

wallpaper_green.prompt: dark green striped wallpaper above a dark wooden wainscot

wood_panel.prompt: dark polished wooden wall panels with thin brass trim

plaster_cream.prompt: plain cream plaster interior wall with faint cracks

cliff_rock.prompt: a craggy brown rock cliff face with small ledges and cracks

cliff_snow.prompt: an icy grey rock cliff face with snow on the small ledges

roof_tin.prompt: grey tin sheets with standing seams
